svg.title: 03-hdfs-read

g.text: ratings.csv is 4 blocks, each stored on 3 of the DataNodes A-E.
Step 1: the client asks the NameNode, not the DataNodes.
Step 2: the NameNode answers with WHERE each block lives. No file data.
Step 3: block 1 lives on A, C, E; read it straight from DataNode A.
Step 3: block 2 lives on B, D, A; read it straight from DataNode B.
Step 3: block 3 lives on C, E, B; read it straight from DataNode C.
Step 3: block 4 lives on D, A, C; read it straight from DataNode D.
All 4 blocks read. The NameNode only answered the lookup.

svg.text: 12 / 12 The NameNode never touched the bytes
